rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a major advance, including progress in science or breaching an enemy line.

example.english: This new drug study has finally made a breakthrough.
example.traditional: 呢項新藥研究終於有突破。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 san1 joek6 jin4 gau3 zung1 jyu1 jau5 duk1 po3

rows.note: Use this specifically for breaking out through encircling enemy forces rather than for a general military advance.

example.english: We made a breakthrough at night and finally broke out of the encirclement.
example.traditional: 我哋趁天黑突圍，終於殺出重圍。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 can3 tin1 hak1 duk1 wai4 zung1 jyu1 saat3 ceot1 cung4 wai4
